subject: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags

Team,

Quick standing request for this month's pipeline hygiene pass — we need a clean snapshot for finance by EOD Friday so FP&A can lock the renewal forecast. Please do the following on the attached export (pipeline_export_MAR18.csv):

- Confirm stage is accurate for any ARR > $10k (move to "renewal confirmed" / "at-risk" / "stalled").
- Add a one-line rationale in column "stage_notes" for any move to At-Risk.
- Mark any deals with renewal date in the next 90 days that have no renewal owner as "owner_missing".

Two specific asks:
1) Marissa: prioritize the top-20 by ARR and flag any that require legal/finance for amendments.
2) Ben: run a quick churn-risk heuristic (usage drop >25% or >30 days since last contact) and add a risk tag.

I'm CC'ing Michael to keep fin-ops aware. Naomi, if you see anything that looks like a forecast mis-apply (wrong ARR recognition), call it out in the sheet so we can correct before Friday.

I'll consolidate updates Wednesday morning and push the roll-up to FP&A.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Renewals Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags

On Mon, Mar 18, 2028 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
>
> Quick standing request for this month's pipeline hygiene pass — we need a clean snapshot for finance by EOD Friday so FP&A can lock the renewal forecast...

Got it — I'm starting with the top-20 ARR list now. Early notes:
- BrightByte (renewal 2028-04-15): no signed amendment in CRM; outreach log shows last contact 35 days ago. Suspect at-risk.
- ClearWave (renewal 2028-05-02): product usage steady; procurement indicated an internal hold (finance-ops@clearwave.io).

I'll attach a short pull (brightbyte_risk_note.txt) with account-level context and will flag any items needing legal.

Question: if Ben tags an account as "high_risk" should we move stage to "At-Risk" immediately or wait until we've attempted outreach? I'm inclined to move to At-Risk so FP&A counts it as downside, but want to align.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior CSM, Renewal Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags

On Mon, Mar 18, 2028 at 11:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Question: if Ben tags an account as "high_risk" should we move stage to "At-Risk" immediately or wait until we've attempted outreach?

Karthik / Marissa — set stage to At-Risk when any of the following are true:
- Usage decline >25% quarter-over-quarter AND no committed renewal conversation in CRM.
- >30 days since last customer contact and renewal within 90 days.
- Outstanding legal/finance docs not received within 10 business days of request.

I'll run the churn heuristic against the export now and will add a short row-level note for flagged accounts. Preliminary high-risk list: BrightByte, ClearWave, and two smaller tactical pilots (IDs in the sheet).

I'll also recommend immediate outreach for BrightByte — tagging Naomi to draft a finance-oriented outreach (billing + renewal viability).

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Renewal Strategy, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags

Thanks for the flags — I'm drafting a concise finance outreach template and will include two paths:
A) Payment/AMENDMENT catch-up (if outstanding docs).
B) Executive check-in + usage remediation (if adoption drop).

For BrightByte, I'll send the outreach first thing Tuesday and copy Sarah (their finance lead). If we don't get response within 3 business days, we escalate to an exec-level note and recommend FP&A treat as downside.

Also uploaded a stage update snapshot to Drive (stage_update_snapshot.xlsx) with the first-pass corrections I made for deals under $50k. Please review the top-20 changes in the sheet; I left comments where I wasn't 100% on contract dates.

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Finance Operations Manager
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly pipeline cleanse + late renewal flags

Great progress today — appreciate the quick turnaround. Final roll-up and action items: 

- Marissa: own outreach cadence for BrightByte and ClearWave. Use Naomi's two-path template; mark attempts in CRM and update the sheet. Deadline: Wed 18:00 PT.
- Ben: finalize churn-risk tags and add a 1-sentence remediation suggestion per flagged account. Deadline: Tue noon PT.
- Naomi: after first outreach (or no response window), update FP&A and set the forecast adjustment flag for any accounts we move to At-Risk. Deadline: Fri COB PT.

I'll compile the consolidated export and send to FP&A Friday AM with the recommended downside adjustment. If anyone needs me to escalate to an AE or solutions lead before Wednesday, ping me directly.

I'll also loop Sarah at BrightByte if/when we need to confirm billing details (no external ping yet — wait for the first outreach).

Thanks again — we'll treat this as the canonical hygiene pass for March.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Renewals Ops, Redwood Inference
